name: ddd-expert
description: Strategic EventStorming, sparse Tactical Design, implementation, and review

interface.longDescription: DDD workflow that builds a compact strategic model through EventStorming, then uses a relentless one question at a time Tactical Design interview to maintain the current domain-object design. Codify implements accepted object slices without changing design authority, and Guard reviews the result independently.
defaultPrompt: Use $ddd-expert:event-storming to clarify the user's purpose and identify confirmed Bounded Contexts and Aggregate Roots. Then use $ddd-expert:tactical-design to question domain objects depth-first, confirm one Aggregate Root at a time, and record its definitions, Facts, Lifecycle State, behavior, and actual Domain Events before $ddd-expert:codify implements them.
